competences.description: Attacks the enemy to grant Silence for 1 turn with a 50% chance and block the target from removing harmful effects for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: Skills with cooldowns will be locked. (Passive skills not included)

Harmful effects cannot be removed while this effect is on. This effect will be removed first when a harmful effect removal skill is used, and other harmful effects can be removed afterwards. Does not apply to bosses.

competences.description: Attacks the enemy to grant Oblivion for 2 turns with an 80% chance and stuns for 1 turn with a 30% chance.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.

competences.description: When the enemy removes harmful effects or an ally's beneficial effects, beneficial effects granted on the enemy target are removed together. Afterwards, removes 1 harmful effect from yourself and the ally with the highest Attack Bar and increases both's Attack Bar by 20%. [Automatic Effect]

effets.description: Removes one or more beneficial effects from target monster(s)
effets.note: When the enemy removes harmful effects, and the ally with the highest attack bar
Ally with highest attack bar is cleansed..

effets.description: The ATK bar of ally monsters is filled by a set amount. This allows ally monsters to attack again sooner.
effets.note: Ally with highest attack bar is boosted.
